purpose: The core terms of the public texts with exactly one spelling per language, and the list of what 3.0 has removed and no public file may name any more. The source of the terms is the code (lib/provenance.ts, lib/workspace-model.ts, lib/abap/abcd-classification.ts) and DESIGN.md; this file invents no term, it only fixes the spelling. Held by tests/public-texts-guard.spec.ts, check (a) retired and (b) terms.

terms[].source: where the term is defined in the code or in DESIGN.md
terms[].en: the one English spelling (interface, README, everything English)
terms[].de: the one German spelling (DESIGN.md, ROADMAP.md, German runbooks); null where the English term also applies in German
terms[].variants[]: deviations the guard counts: pattern (JavaScript RegExp source), flags, note
terms[].baseline: number of hits per variant on the reference date, over all files for which the inventory sets guard.terms = check

retired[].patterns[]: RegExp sources; a hit is a violation unless the line matches allowIfLine or the global negationLine
retired[].allowIfLine: optional: RegExp source that clears the line (e.g. 'als Werkzeuge' for the seven stages)
retired[].samples: hit/allowed: sample lines on which the guard checks its own expressions (self-test, runs from now on)
retired[].baseline: number of hits on the reference date, over all files with guard.removed = check
retired[].decided: optional: a decision on the reading of the removal, with date

schema.negationLine: A line that explicitly names the removed thing as removed or not built is not a violation — it describes the 3.0 state. The line is checked together with its preceding line, because Markdown wraps sentences ('Deliberately not built: tenants, SSO,' / 'ALM adapters, portfolio steering.'). Heuristic, deliberately kept narrow.

negationLine: (not built|nicht gebaut|deliberately not|bewusst nicht|entf(ae|ä)llt|removed|entfernt|gestrichen|no longer|nicht mehr|retired|dropped|there is no|no connection to|keine Anbindung|gibt es nicht|❌|kein(e|en|er)? (Dark Mode|dark mode|SSO|Signavio-API)|no (dark mode|SSO|Signavio API))
